categories.main_business_segments: Qingdao Daneng Environmental Protection Equipment Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the design, manufacturing, installation, and sales of energy-saving and environmental protection equipment. Its main product lines include slag energy-saving treatment systems, flue gas energy-saving treatment systems, full-load denitrification systems, clean energy consumption systems, desulfurization wastewater treatment systems, steel slag treatment systems, and related spare parts. The company serves industries such as power generation, thermal energy, chemical, metallurgy, waste treatment, and new energy sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes proprietary technologies such as axial chain transmission, scale bucket conveyor belts, closed self-cleaning technology, penetrating cooling technology, and quantitative air control. It has developed advanced systems like dry and wet slag treatment, low-temperature flue gas deep heat recovery, full-load denitrification, and zero-discharge desulfurization wastewater treatment. Production incorporates digital transformation, intelligent automation, and lean manufacturing, utilizing 5G IoT, robotics, and AI for enhanced efficiency and quality control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include large industrial enterprises in power generation (notably coal-fired power plants), thermal power, chemical, metallurgy, mining, and new energy sectors. The company maintains strong relationships with major national energy groups such as State Energy Investment Group, China Energy Engineering Group, Shanghai Electric, State Power Investment Corporation, and China Huadian Corporation. Its products are tailored to meet the specific operational conditions of these industries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with significant market presence in East China, North China, Northwest China, Central South China, Southwest China, Northeast China, Hong Kong, Macau, Taiwan, and expanding overseas with subsidiaries in Indonesia, Singapore, and Malaysia. The establishment of an Indonesian subsidiary marks a strategic step in international market expansion focusing on smart power plants and environmental technology upgrades.
categories.supply_chain_position: Qingdao Daneng operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and installation of environmental protection equipment. It procures raw materials such as steel and electromechanical components, manufactures customized equipment, and delivers integrated solutions and services directly to end customers in various industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation and R&D, focusing on energy-saving, emission reduction, clean energy integration, and digital intelligence. Key R&D projects include advanced denitrification systems, heat recovery technologies, zero-discharge wastewater treatment, hydrogen energy equipment, and AI-driven intelligent control systems. It collaborates with universities and research institutes, maintains a robust patent portfolio, and invests significantly in developing new materials and smart manufacturing technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of customized environmental protection equipment and integrated engineering contracting (EPC) services. The company also earns income from maintenance services and BOT (Build-Operate-Transfer) projects. Sales are mostly direct to industrial clients via bidding and contracts, with some sales through e-commerce platforms and strategic partnerships.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Qingdao Daneng is positioned as a leading technology-driven enterprise in the energy-saving and environmental protection equipment sector in China. It holds a strong competitive edge due to its proprietary technologies, comprehensive product portfolio, and extensive industry certifications. The company competes with other specialized environmental equipment manufacturers and engineering contractors, maintaining a significant market share especially in coal-fired power plant environmental solutions.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.314 billion, representing a 27.67% year-over-year increase. Net profit attributable to shareholders was about RMB 92.97 million, up 7.26% from the previous year. Total assets reached RMB 3.076 billion, growing 59.66% year-over-year. The company has shown steady growth supported by expanding market demand and new project developments, including a significant increase in R&D investment.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Qingdao Daneng emphasizes its unique value through advanced proprietary technologies, high-quality customized solutions, and integrated services that address comprehensive environmental challenges across solid, liquid, and gas waste streams. Its products offer superior energy efficiency, environmental compliance, and digital intelligence capabilities, enabling clients to meet stringent emission standards and achieve sustainable operations. The company’s strong R&D capabilities and extensive patent portfolio further differentiate it in the competitive landscape.
